rule_title: The Apache web server must have Web Distributed Authoring (WebDAV) disabled.
check_text:
In a command line, run "httpd -M | sort" to view a list of installed modules.

If any of the following modules are present, this is a finding:

dav_module
dav_fs_module
dav_lock_module
